fusions.name: Split on the Score
fusions.desc: A chop that deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.2 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Chips Off the Block
fusions.desc: A chop across the front that deals 11 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles ahead of you, knocks each enemy back 2 tiles and leaves it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Broken-Glass Coping
fusions.desc: Raises a wall 5 tiles long in front of you that blocks movement for 8 seconds. Enemies that touch it are left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bedding Plane
fusions.desc: Your slashing attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
